rows.target_brief: Full main-road width between fixed A/B terminal cross-sections; access forecourts excluded.
rows.notes: Main road runs diagonally across the frame. Bare crowns overlap the northwest curb and outer lane repeatedly; native crops show branches and shadows mixed at that edge. Southeast curb and access mouth are visible, but a complete reliable northwest boundary is not available. No canopy-hidden edge was invented.
uncertainties: Full northwest road boundary beneath overlapping branches is uncertain.
Road overlap by branches versus their shadows is not resolved throughout the fixed interval.

rows.notes: The narrow north-south road is visible in the south, but its northern fixed endpoint and upper interval are buried beneath structural debris and vegetation. Native crops confirm extensive material over the expected corridor; its full width cannot be traced reliably.

rows.target_brief: Full main-road width between fixed A/B terminal cross-sections; access forecourts excluded.
rows.notes: Original small frame was inspected at native size with guide. The north-south paved lane is recognizable, but dense crowns and deep shadows conceal long sections of both margins, especially the eastern side. A small vehicle near A does not by itself establish an obstacle.
uncertainties: Full width beneath crowns cannot be traced across the fixed interval.

rows.target_brief: Full main-road width between fixed A/B terminal cross-sections; access forecourts excluded.
rows.notes: Native crops show a diagonal paved route adjoining broad building forecourts. The northwest side merges into unbounded paved access areas and the southeast margin near A is covered by damaged vegetation. Scattered panels and branches are visible, but a complete main-road polygon cannot be established from continuous visible edges.
uncertainties: Main-road versus connected forecourt boundary is unclear near A.
Vegetation conceals portions of the southeast margin.

rows.notes: The curving residential road is visible through much of the interval; native crops show several driveway vehicles, nearby debris and shadows. The fixed B terminal lies in the black unavailable image area, so its cross-section and the last part of the route cannot be checked.
